architectural_decisions.rationale: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform. [...] It increases system security by reducing the gateways to the outside, since the only way to interact with the microservices is through the Api Gateway.
The decision was made to use AWS and not other cloud services due to its low price and its previous use by the company.
This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
It has been decided to use this language, and not JavaScript, because it is the default language for NestJS and because thanks to its static typing it allows the detection of errors at compile time.

The objective was to develop the necessary infrastructure that would allow us to manage, obtain and store the data of the playlogs, connections and actions on the platform. To achieve this, different AWS services have been used that have allowed us to develop a data lake.
For the data transmission to be as fast as possible, two Amazon services have been used, which allow us to perform a transmission in near real time.
